sentences.text: The holotype specimen of Wieslochia consists of a dissociated skeleton preserved on two slabs.
A second specimen containing a mandible and a cranium was found in the same geological area as the holotype.
Wieslochia is classified within the parent group Passeriformes.
A 2024 study suggests that Wieslochia and the related genus Crosnoornis belong to the Tyranni, likely as stem or crown group members of the Eurylaimides.
Wieslochia lived in Germany during the early Oligocene, approximately 27.8 million years ago.
The time range for Wieslochia is estimated to be between 33.9 and 27.3 million years ago.
